'''Josh Obrien''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Mastic tournament]] on 29 August 1999 with No Shelter, according to Tony Garcia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d27">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-01-mastic-ny-8-29-99d27/ mastic-ny-8-29-99], DeckTech (Tony "Don Fat Tony" Garcia, 1 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-01-mastic-ny-8-29-99d27/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
